summary: TipHaus is tip-distribution, tip-pooling, and payroll-export software for restaurants/hospitality, syncing with POS systems (Toast, Aloha, Micros, Square, Clover, SkyTab) roughly every 15 minutes and offering an "Earned Tip Access" same-day tip payout feature alongside a free employee web app for tip visibility.

TipHaus states that over 500,000 hospitality professionals and 200,000+ hospitality managers use its platform for daily tip management and payouts. (Scope note: Vendor-reported user-count statistic, not independently verified.)
